blurb: Discover Montreal and his surroundings as you've never seen before as you fly overhead in a helicopter. See the Olympic Stadium, Downtown Montreal, Mount Royal and more from the best perspective out there with our Montreal Tour. Fly along the Saint-Lawrence's river with our Saint-Laurent circuit and go over the Parc Jean Drapeau, and Jacques Cartier Bridge. Explore this beautiful city in a totally unique way in this unforgettable tour.
